comment: Scripted helpers with no in-script reference. Each entry is a pre-existing, preload-clean helper that is kept instead of deleted because removing shipped content needs an explicit product decision; the reason must state why leaving it is safe. Anything not listed here fails tools/content_reachability.py, so dead content cannot accumulate silently.

unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_is_chinese_heritage_country: Shared lore trigger kept as a readable alias; the runtime checks use the inline heritage-variable comparison instead.
unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_has_high_heritage_legitimacy: Threshold helper mirroring var:ywc_heritage_legitimacy >= 70; the events compare the variable inline.
unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_has_low_heritage_legitimacy: Threshold helper mirroring var:ywc_heritage_legitimacy <= 30; the events compare the variable inline.
unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_has_high_maritime_network: Threshold helper mirroring var:ywc_maritime_network_level >= 60; route effects compare the variable inline.
unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_has_high_autonomy_pressure: Threshold helper mirroring var:ywc_autonomy_pressure >= 70; the negotiation effects compare the variable inline.
unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_has_ep1_content: DLC gate duplicated by the inline has_dlc_feature = ep1_content check in ywc_apply_dlc_compatibility.
unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_has_mp1_content: DLC gate duplicated by the inline has_dlc_feature = mp1_content check in ywc_apply_dlc_compatibility.
unused_scripted_helpers.ywc_has_ep2_content: DLC gate duplicated by the inline has_dlc_feature = ep2_content check in ywc_apply_dlc_compatibility.
